title: Applicant age eligibility
statement: Applicants must be between 21 and 60 years of age, inclusive.
normalized_intent: Applicant age must be within the inclusive range 21 to 60.
subject: LOAN_APPLICANT

source.source_text: Applicants must be between 21 and 60 years of age, inclusive.

title: Minimum monthly salary
statement: Applicants must have a minimum monthly salary of INR 30,000.
normalized_intent: Applicant monthly salary must be at least INR 30,000.
subject: LOAN_APPLICANT

source.source_text: Applicants must have a minimum monthly salary of INR 30,000.

title: Salary credit history
statement: The applicant's salary must have been credited to the bank for at least six consecutive months.
normalized_intent: Require at least six consecutive months of salary credits to the bank.
subject: LOAN_APPLICANT

source.source_text: The applicant's salary must have been credited to the bank for at least six consecutive months.

title: Loan amount range
statement: The minimum personal loan amount is INR 50,000. The maximum personal loan amount is INR 25,00,000.
normalized_intent: Loan principal must be between INR 50,000 and INR 2,500,000.
subject: PERSONAL_LOAN

source.source_text: The minimum personal loan amount is INR 50,000. The maximum personal loan amount is INR 25,00,000.

title: High-value loan approval
statement: Loan applications with an amount greater than INR 10,00,000 require approval from two levels: a Manager followed by a Senior Manager.
normalized_intent: Route applications above INR 1,000,000 through Manager and then Senior Manager approval.
subject: LOAN_APPLICATION

source.source_text: Loan applications with an amount greater than INR 10,00,000 require approval from two levels: a Manager followed by a Senior Manager.

title: Standard loan approval
statement: Applications with an amount of INR 10,00,000 or less require approval from one Manager.
normalized_intent: Route applications at or below INR 1,000,000 through one Manager approval.
subject: LOAN_APPLICATION

source.source_text: Applications with an amount of INR 10,00,000 or less require approval from one Manager.

title: High-risk applicant verification
statement: High-risk applicants should undergo additional verification.
normalized_intent: Additional verification is required for high-risk applicants, but the trigger and procedure are unspecified.
subject: LOAN_APPLICANT

source.source_text: High-risk applicants should undergo additional verification.
